name: Approve release boundaries, lifecycle and business rules
scope: Validate debt-paper semantics, issuance/rejection, notification, payment, enforcement and closure states; define correction/cancellation/resubmission and official identifiers.
remaining_work: Review existing domain documents with business owners; resolve competing state vocabularies and formula meanings; produce signed decision tables and representative examples.
parallelization: Alongside A2–A5; supplies increments to C/E.
uncertainty: High: no signed decisions supplied; allow two review rounds. More policy variants require re-estimation.
acceptance_criteria: Named owners approve state/transition matrix, data dictionary, money units, identifiers and normal/exception examples; unresolved items have explicit release decisions.

name: Finalize inbound API and versioned XML contract
scope: Specify transport authentication, reference identity, XML namespaces/repeated elements, mandatory fields, date semantics, money decomposition, error codes, hash meaning and evolution.
remaining_work: Obtain official XML samples and provider review; map every required field to source/model; settle envelope/XML conflicts and reference replay semantics; record missing fields.
parallelization: Can begin with A1; must align final contract with A1 before C4 acceptance.
uncertainty: High: official XSD and provider approval absent. Provider waiting time is additional.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned request/response and XML examples approved by both sides; all model-required data sourced; duplicate, correction and validation responses specified.

name: Approve role, organization and delegation matrix
scope: Define role/action/organization/state permissions, admin separation of duties, assignment, return, substitution and absence; include case reports and integration administration.
remaining_work: Resolve failing admin-assignment expectation; determine local-profile versus identity-provider authority; approve target-user eligibility and field-level task permissions.
roles: BA, security engineer, TL, business owner
parallelization: Alongside contract and platform analysis; gates B4/E5/F1.
uncertainty: High: current code and test express conflicting admin policy.
acceptance_criteria: Signed matrix covers all APIs and task transitions, cross-unit denial, disabled users, delegation and privileged exceptions.

name: Inventory providers and secure test access
scope: Identify owners, protocols, quotas, credentials, network routes, sandboxes, callback reachability and support contacts for every business integration.
remaining_work: Separate company registry, Official Gazette and restriction destination responsibilities; include SANIM issuance/rejection/notification results and SMS, not just the original four services.
roles: Integration BE, BA, SRE, provider contacts
parallelization: Run immediately with A1/A2; provider approvals proceed in parallel.
uncertainty: High: elapsed provisioning/approval can be 2–8+ weeks and is not bounded by this effort.
acceptance_criteria: Provider register has agreed interface owner, sample contract, test account, tested network path, quotas and dated joint-test slots for every required provider.

name: Set capacity, availability and deployment decisions
scope: Agree concurrent users, peak/batch traffic, nine-million-record retention/migration scope, active workflow count, SLOs, RPO/RTO, target database and hosting topology.
remaining_work: Inspect actual Camunda/Keycloak deployment with operators; choose organization-approved relational database and frontend serving model; size an initial staging environment.
parallelization: Alongside business/contracts; gates platform implementation.
uncertainty: High: daily average does not reveal bursts, nine million active workflows or read demand; server topology is outside repository.
acceptance_criteria: Approved architecture decision records include quantified load/SLO/RPO/RTO, storage growth, ownership and whether historical records need active workflows.

name: Specify missing enforcement and non-tax workflows
status: Mostly missing; limited case UI exists
scope: Detail arrest-order approval/dispatch, case composition, government/non-tax claim intake and closure/reopening; distinguish issuing an order from full asset seizure/auction.
remaining_work: Produce fields, roles, documents, state transitions and failure scenarios; explicitly decide attachment/signature requirements and provider dependencies.
parallelization: Alongside C/D implementation once initial rules are stable.
uncertainty: High/provisional: titles alone do not define these features. Baseline assumes limited order issuance/dispatch and one non-tax source.
acceptance_criteria: Business owner approves executable stories and UAT scenarios for E6–E9; scope exclusions and any additional provider work documented.

name: Contain committed credentials and unsafe defaults
scope: Inventory committed credential defaults and privileged bootstrap access; coordinate revocation/rotation, runtime replacement and repository/history exposure review.
remaining_work: Remove secret fallback values; obtain new credentials through operator-owned secret store; verify old credentials are revoked without printing their values.
parallelization: Immediate; independent of business decisions.
uncertainty: Medium: access to identity and workflow administrators required; history cleanup may affect consumers.
acceptance_criteria: No usable secret defaults in tracked configuration or release artifacts; rotation/revocation evidence retained; missing required secrets prevents production startup.

name: Isolate demo utilities and production bootstrap
scope: Separate fake endpoints, random data, test-start/reset paths, user/demo seeds and sample UI from the production composition.
remaining_work: Add explicit development/test boundaries and production startup guards; replace worker dependencies through D1; separate approved reference-data seeding from fabricated users/data.
parallelization: Can start immediately; production proof follows D2–D7 and G1.
uncertainty: Medium: disabling controllers alone leaves fake services inside workers; random behavior also resides in RelatedPersonService.
acceptance_criteria: Production boot on empty DB creates no demo people or papers; reset/test/fake routes unavailable; production provider graph contains no fake dependency; release scan enforces this.

name: Harden identity-provider integration and user lifecycle
scope: Harden issuer/audience/client trust, role/group mapping, least-privilege service accounts and user enable/lock/revoke behavior across every API.
remaining_work: Provision versioned realm/client settings; reject inappropriate token audiences; consistently enforce business-disabled/locked/unprovisioned policy; remove reliance on bootstrap users.
parallelization: Alongside sessions, database and provider adapters.
uncertainty: Medium–high: deployed realm configuration and corporate SSO requirements unavailable; federation beyond current Keycloak is excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Wrong issuer/audience and revoked/disabled identities denied on cartable, reports and administration; realm configuration reproducible; role changes have an approved maximum propagation time.

name: Enforce resource and organization authorization
scope: Apply shared organization scope to case search/detail/trace/related persons/reports, assignment targets and every write; validate permitted task completion variables.
remaining_work: Close permission-only report access and unscoped assignment; prevent clients changing paper IDs, organization IDs or workflow control variables outside approved forms; split view and mutation grants.
parallelization: Alongside B3/C; shared service contracts coordinated with E5/F2.
uncertainty: High: intended organization boundaries and legacy admin exceptions require confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: Negative tests deny cross-unit reads/writes, malicious task variables, unauthorized assignment and disabled users; UI visibility never substitutes for backend enforcement.

name: Implement session refresh, expiry and browser coordination
scope: Complete PKCE token lifecycle, refresh rotation, reload/multi-tab synchronization, idle/absolute expiry, logout, safe return paths and network-error behavior.
remaining_work: Choose approved token-storage design; implement single-flight refresh with cross-tab coordination and bounded retries; preserve unsaved form state where appropriate; test IDP logout and invalid_grant.
parallelization: Alongside integration/workflow development.
uncertainty: Medium–high: baseline retains current browser OIDC architecture after review; mandatory BFF redesign adds work.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent expiry triggers one coordinated refresh; transient network failure preserves valid login; 403 does not logout; expired refresh ends session; reload, multi-tab logout and role revocation pass browser tests.

name: Harden API transport, validation and callback trust
scope: Protect callback identity/replay, inbound sizes/rates, CORS/TLS/security headers, XML depth/size, browser injection and sensitive output; define a threat model.
remaining_work: Replace public fake callback with authenticated provider contract; configure allowlisted origins and TLS paths; enforce bounds and field validation; review error/trace redaction.
parallelization: Shared patterns developed with D1; provider-specific wiring in D2–D7.
uncertainty: Medium: provider authentication choice and organizational perimeter controls not supplied; basic XXE protection already exists.
acceptance_criteria: Unsigned/unauthorized/replayed callbacks and oversized/deep XML rejected; approved origins work; payloads cannot alter protected state; transport and headers verified at deployment edge.

name: Make audit and retention operationally reliable
scope: Cover sensitive reads, rule/permission changes, provider events and lifecycle transitions with actor, source, correlation and before/after audit; govern retention and deletion.
remaining_work: Define audit-access policy and tamper resistance; prevent operational reset/deletion of evidence; record failed/ambiguous external operations durably; minimize taxpayer data in logs/workflow variables.
parallelization: Alongside C/E; central log shipping owned by G4.
uncertainty: High: retention and evidentiary requirements need owner approval; no legal compliance certification assumed.
acceptance_criteria: Critical events have attributable, queryable audit records; denied access and changes are covered; retention job and restricted deletion tested; sensitive values excluded from general logs.

name: Prepare target database and schema baseline
scope: Adapt existing entities/manual DDL to selected database; configure driver, dialect, pool, users, encoding and baseline automated versioned migrations.
remaining_work: Reconcile 33-table local schema with models and six manual SQL scripts; remove production ddl-auto update/startup mutation; test clean creation and upgrades.
parallelization: Alongside B and contract completion; domain increments follow C2.
uncertainty: Medium–high: assumes one supported relational database with ordinary JPA compatibility; unusual vendor mandates require spike.
acceptance_criteria: Empty DB and representative prior schema reach same version using migrations; application uses validation-only schema mode and least-privilege runtime user.

name: Correct money, dates, keys and concurrency model
scope: Use exact agreed monetary representation end-to-end; formalize Jalali/date/time boundaries, IDs, uniqueness, referential constraints and concurrent state updates.
remaining_work: Replace Double/default-zero financial semantics across DTOs/entities/rules/UI; backfill typed dates without silent today fallbacks; add domain-appropriate uniqueness and optimistic/conditional updates.
parallelization: Alongside D1 and B; coordinate shared DTO changes.
uncertainty: High: historic values may be ambiguous; exact rial integer versus decimal scale and calendar semantics await business decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Boundary money/date fixtures round-trip without precision loss; invalid dates rejected; concurrent writes cannot lose state or duplicate domain identities; dirty records quarantined with reconciliation report.

name: Load and govern authoritative organization/reference data
scope: Manage official directorate/office/unit hierarchy and codes, taxpayer/activity/tax-source/post values, effective dates and organization transfers.
remaining_work: Replace fabricated initializers; validate parent relationships and external code to internal ID mapping; import authoritative lists with repeatable updates and referential checks.
parallelization: Alongside C2 and providers; gates realistic issuance/authorization tests.
uncertainty: High: mapping currently treats received tax-office/unit values as local IDs; code lists and change ownership absent.
acceptance_criteria: Official codes resolve reproducibly; invalid hierarchy rejected; repeat import creates no duplicates; moved/retired organizations preserve historical access and references.

name: Complete versioned debt intake and XML mapping
scope: Implement finalized contract, nested/repeated XML mapping, all debt components, identities, source timestamps, optionality and stable error responses.
remaining_work: Replace alias/first-leaf heuristics and zero-filled debt fields; validate envelope/XML agreement and hash if contractual; unify or retire legacy issuance entry point without bypass.
parallelization: Alongside real outbound adapters; transport hardening shared with B6.
uncertainty: High: contract not final; source hash currently stored, not verified; contract changes beyond two review cycles excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Approved natural/legal and exceptional XML fixtures map exactly; missing debt components never silently become valid zero; unsupported versions rejected; legacy path cannot bypass business/security rules.

name: Durably coordinate intake and workflow startup
status: Partial; failure state exists, recovery missing
scope: Guarantee recoverable transition from persisted paper to workflow start using a durable intent/outbox and stable business identity; reconcile ambiguous acknowledgements.
remaining_work: Persist process-instance linkage and attempt state; implement dispatcher, retry/reconcile and operator replay; distinguish duplicate same payload from conflicting resubmission on both intake paths.
parallelization: Alongside D/E; shared persistence primitives coordinated with E1.
uncertainty: High: DB commit and external process creation are not one transaction; provider timeout can mean success with lost acknowledgement.
acceptance_criteria: Crash tests before/after DB commit and accepted-but-unacknowledged workflow start recover to one intended business execution; no stranded paper requires SQL repair; conflicting replay is visible and blocked.

name: Rehearse application-data migration and reconciliation
scope: Transfer approved existing application/reference data to target DB, excluding fabricated demo records; validate relationships, totals, counts and upgrade rollback.
remaining_work: Build dry-run/export/import scripts, exception quarantine and cutover checks; reconcile schema drift and exact-money/date conversion with signed totals.
parallelization: Alongside functional completion; production run follows H6.
uncertainty: Medium: covers existing application data only, not nine-million legacy-case ingestion; that is M1–M3.
acceptance_criteria: Two repeatable migrations produce agreed record counts and monetary totals, no orphan references or demo data; rollback rehearsed against retained source.

name: Optimize case queries and large-volume reporting
scope: Bound pagination, remove per-row repository lookups, optimize filters and count queries, add measured indexes and aggregate/read models where needed.
remaining_work: Profile target-DB plans on nine-million-scale synthetic records; replace rejected-payload full parsing and global dashboard calculations; test hot concurrent writes.
parallelization: Alongside workflow tuning; final validation in H4.
uncertainty: Medium–high: real query distribution and hardware unknown; no unmeasured partitioning/rewrite assumed.
acceptance_criteria: At approved peak mix, report/list p95 and DB saturation meet A5 targets; pagination remains correct beyond first page and large history; query plans and load evidence retained.

name: Create shared production integration adapters
scope: Introduce provider interfaces and production/test implementations with shared transport configuration, bounded timeouts, retries/backoff, correlation and status vocabulary.
remaining_work: Move fake implementations to tests/demo composition; implement reusable durable request/inbox infrastructure with terminal, retryable and unknown outcomes; define redacted diagnostics.
parallelization: Parallel to C4 and E design; provider-specific tests remain in D2–D7.
uncertainty: Medium: transport protocols unknown; estimates assume conventional HTTP/SOAP or gateway integration, not a new broker/platform.
acceptance_criteria: One adapter contract supports test and production providers; timeout/retry/idempotency policies exercised without duplicates; startup rejects incomplete production provider configuration.

name: Integrate electronic notification and delivery evidence
scope: Send approved execution document/data, consume authenticated delivery outcomes and dates, support status inquiry and delivery evidence references.
remaining_work: Map real provider request/status/receipt semantics; implement duplicate/late/conflicting callback handling; retain tracking and failed-delivery work queue; joint-test with provider.
parallelization: Alongside D3–D7 with separate adapter owners; E3 uses its contract.
uncertainty: High: official notification API, attachments and evidence format unavailable; certified signing is not assumed.
acceptance_criteria: Provider sandbox demonstrates accepted, delivered, rejected, timed-out, duplicate and corrected outcomes; verified delivery time/evidence persists and reliably advances only matching workflow.

name: Integrate taxpayer SMS
scope: Implement approved trigger events/templates, authoritative phone source, send tracking, delivery receipt/status lookup and rate limiting.
remaining_work: Add SMS adapter and durable dispatch; define duplicate suppression and missing phone handling; make technical delivery status distinct from legal notification.
parallelization: Alongside all other adapters.
uncertainty: High: no phone contract, trigger rules or SMS API found; priority assumes SMS is required in original release.
acceptance_criteria: Approved triggers send exactly the intended message under replay; missing/invalid numbers and provider failure are actionable; SMS never falsely marks legal notification complete.

name: Integrate related-person sources and provenance
status: Mocked; random changes in domain service
scope: Implement authoritative company/board membership lookup and temporal relationship reconciliation, retaining source IDs, dates and provenance.
remaining_work: Replace FakeCompanyRegistry/FakeOfficialGazette usage and random expiry; reconcile source disagreement, pagination, empty/stale responses and historical board membership; joint-test.
parallelization: Alongside notification and debt adapters; E4 can develop against fixtures.
uncertainty: High: assumes at most two simple related-person interfaces; source authority and historical coverage unresolved.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated identical input produces identical memberships; no random mutation; official historical fixtures identify the correct members for debt date; conflicts are visible and do not silently impose restrictions.

name: Integrate restriction application and removal provider
scope: Send person-specific restriction and release requests; consume per-person outcomes and current status; reconcile partial success and delayed responses.
remaining_work: Implement real adapter, stable request IDs, status inquiry and controlled resend/compensation; establish provider test evidence for apply and release.
parallelization: Alongside D4; orchestration is E4, not repeated here.
uncertainty: High: destination capabilities, release semantics and partial-success handling unknown.
acceptance_criteria: Real test environment proves application and removal with duplicate/partial/failure cases; no inferred success from transport acknowledgement alone.

name: Integrate authoritative payment/debt inquiry
scope: Fetch debt/payment/credit/penalty snapshots with stable request identity, taxpayer/debt scope, source timestamp and callback or polling semantics.
remaining_work: Replace fake inquiry and local SANIM-audit dependency; handle stale/out-of-order responses and same-request conflicts; implement provider limits and contract tests.
parallelization: Alongside D2/D4; E3 schedules consumption.
uncertainty: High: current result is taxpayer-scoped; one taxpayer may have multiple debts. Authority of balances and identifiers must be confirmed.
acceptance_criteria: Multiple-paper taxpayer fixtures update correct scope; stale responses cannot overwrite newer balances; duplicates are harmless; provider test totals match stored exact values.

name: Integrate SANIM issuance, rejection and notification results
scope: Publish execution-paper ID, business rejection reason/restriction date and notification result to real operational system.
remaining_work: Replace FakeSanimInformService call sites; negotiate three message shapes and acknowledgement semantics; support status/retry and contradictory response reconciliation.
parallelization: Alongside other providers; E2/E3 use these adapters.
uncertainty: High: these outbound responsibilities are absent from the original four-provider shortlist.
acceptance_criteria: All three outcomes accepted by provider in joint tests; outages/replays do not lose or duplicate business outcomes; support can trace paper to provider acknowledgement.

name: Harden worker side effects and asynchronous recovery
scope: Make worker replay safe across DB/external calls/job completion; persist inbox/outbox state, classify business versus technical failure, and manage callback subscriptions and expiry.
remaining_work: Apply idempotency to issue/send/store/update workers; standardize message IDs/TTL and backoff; add timeout/escalation paths for missing callbacks and operator reconciliation.
parallelization: Alongside adapter implementation; C5 owns initial intake/start only.
uncertainty: High: concurrency and ambiguous acknowledgements require real-engine crash tests; some current message methods already use IDs/TTL.
acceptance_criteria: Repeated jobs/callbacks and worker crashes cannot create duplicate papers/restrictions/notifications; missing responses reach monitored, recoverable incidents; no indefinite invisible waits.

name: Validate issuance and rule-engine behavior
scope: Unify both issuance routes, official unique code, acceptance/rejection decisions and auditable rule versions/effective dates.
remaining_work: Validate rule JSON/operators/fields before activation; replace parse-error skip and numeric-zero fallback with explicit approved blocked/manual outcome; preserve decision snapshot.
parallelization: Alongside E3/E4 after shared rules are stable.
uncertainty: High: malformed rules currently can allow issuance; business owner must define safe handling, not developers guessing statutory policy.
acceptance_criteria: Approved decision tables pass through both entry paths; invalid rules cannot silently permit issuance; duplicate worker execution preserves one paper; generated IDs and rejection acknowledgements satisfy contract.

name: Complete notification deadlines and debt-inquiry scheduling
scope: Connect approved notification states and dates to waiting deadline, debt-inquiry subprocess, retry/escalation and downstream payment decisions.
remaining_work: Add missing timer/call or durable scheduler; validate month/calendar calculation; remove today/time fallbacks; handle refusal/re-notification/cancellation and late callbacks.
parallelization: Alongside E4/E5; adapters can be contract-tested earlier.
uncertainty: High: stored nextDebtInquiryDate alone does not schedule anything; required deadline/calendar rules not approved.
acceptance_criteria: Real-engine accelerated-clock tests reach debt inquiry at approved deadline, once per intended cycle; late/duplicate notification cannot reset deadlines incorrectly; outage and recovery preserve timers.

name: Complete restriction eligibility and release lifecycle
scope: Orchestrate person eligibility by role and membership dates, board changes, application, per-person outcomes and release on approved triggers.
remaining_work: Implement approved rules, freeze decision provenance, handle partial failures and source changes; connect D4/D5; protect against repeat or stale decisions.
roles: Domain BE, workflow BE, QA, SME
parallelization: Alongside E3/E5 with independent BPMN changes.
uncertainty: High: current process largely applies restrictions; release and membership-change policy absent.
acceptance_criteria: Business-approved temporal membership cases and apply/release/reapply/partial-error scenarios pass end-to-end; every affected person has decision evidence and confirmed provider outcome.

name: Complete cartable transitions, delegation and task pagination
scope: Implement approved assignment/claim/return/substitute lifecycle, state consistency and complete task searches with stable pagination.
remaining_work: Replace first-100 retrieval/client filtering and synchronous next-task sleep with robust continuation; validate assignee eligibility; persist business transitions from task decisions.
parallelization: Alongside domain process work; UX shared through F1/F2.
uncertainty: Medium–high: Camunda task-search consistency and deployed API behavior need staging measurement.
acceptance_criteria: Users can retrieve beyond 100 tasks, filter across full authorized set, and delegate/return without orphan work; concurrent claims resolve correctly; paper state and task completion agree.

name: Implement arrest-order approval and dispatch
scope: Add order model, eligibility validation, approval, document/reference, execution-officer routing, acknowledgement and cancellation within approved scope.
remaining_work: Implement API/BPMN/persistence and per-role order screens using F2 components; record immutable order identity and routing audit; handle failed/repeated dispatch.
roles: Domain BE, workflow BE, FE, QA
parallelization: Alongside E7–E9; no full seizure/auction implementation assumed.
uncertainty: Very high/provisional: no arrest-order aggregate or dedicated workflow found. Separate external officer system would add an adapter.
acceptance_criteria: Authorized officer receives approved order; forbidden/unpaid-state mismatches blocked; duplicate dispatch produces no new order; reject/cancel/reassign scenarios pass approved UAT.

name: Complete case file and summary composition
scope: Build approved case summary spanning debt, persons, notification, actions, related people, evidence references and external status with organization scope.
remaining_work: Define case identity versus paper/taxpayer; add missing timeline/document metadata and summary APIs; reconcile financial/status display; implement role-appropriate summary view.
parallelization: Alongside E6/E8/E9; shared reporting logic with F3.
uncertainty: High: assumes references/basic case metadata, not a new enterprise document-management repository.
acceptance_criteria: Approved multi-paper case examples show complete authorized timeline and reconciled totals; print/summary links retain evidence identity and no cross-organization data appears.

name: Implement government/non-tax claim intake and case model
scope: Support one agreed government/non-tax claim source, claimant/debtor identity, enforceable document reference, amount/currency, validation and case linkage.
remaining_work: Add schema/API or approved file import and dedicated validation; distinguish non-tax rules/codes from tax-specific fields; quarantine rejected rows and deduplicate claims.
roles: Domain BE, integration BE, DBA, QA
parallelization: Alongside E6/E7; E9 consumes its case contract.
uncertainty: Very high/provisional: no contract/source model exists; multiple agencies and novel transports excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Official non-tax examples are accepted/rejected with reconciled totals and source IDs; replay creates no duplicates; no fabricated tax fields are required.

name: Implement non-tax case workflow and user actions
scope: Connect non-tax cases to approved review/assignment/notification/enforcement lifecycle with explicit deviations from tax workflow.
remaining_work: Implement workflow variables/decisions and per-role forms; reuse validated adapters where contract permits; produce source acknowledgement and case trace.
parallelization: Alongside closure and final frontend hardening.
uncertainty: Very high/provisional: assumes substantial reuse of tax workflow; materially different government-claim process invalidates range.
acceptance_criteria: Approved non-tax case completes its permitted lifecycle with appropriate roles, reports and audit; tax and non-tax fixtures coexist without rule leakage.

name: Implement closure, cancellation and controlled reopening
scope: Close only on approved reason/evidence, reconcile payment, cancel pending work/timers, release restrictions where required and support authorized reopening.
remaining_work: Create domain transitions/API/BPMN and user actions; persist terminal reason/date and cancellation intent; reconcile provider requests still in flight.
roles: Domain BE, workflow BE, FE, QA
parallelization: Alongside arrest/non-tax completion; final UAT waits on required branches.
uncertainty: High: completing the expert task currently records audit, not a proven case closure transaction; financial and release conditions unresolved.
acceptance_criteria: Closure cannot strand active tasks/restrictions; late callbacks cannot reopen a closed case accidentally; paid, cancelled, disputed and authorized-reopen scenarios preserve audit and balances.

name: Validate role-based UX and information architecture
scope: Review existing dashboard/cartable/case/admin journeys, navigation, error/loading/empty states, Persian RTL and key-role prototypes.
remaining_work: Observe key users, remove duplicate rule-management entry points and define shared form/table patterns; approve menu/page access matrix.
parallelization: Alongside backend/contracts; feeds feature screens.
uncertainty: Medium: assumes improvement of existing application, not a full visual redesign.
acceptance_criteria: Key users approve primary task flows and role menus; demo-only routes identified; prototypes cover waiting/error/no-access and large-table behavior.

name: Implement shared production UI behavior
scope: Apply approved navigation, reusable forms/tables, typed validation, loading/error handling, safe repeated submission, unsaved-change behavior and operational status visibility.
remaining_work: Consolidate common UI/API patterns and remove demo menus; connect server pagination and permissions; feature-specific arrest/non-tax/case screens remain in E6–E10.
parallelization: Alongside E features with shared components frozen incrementally.
uncertainty: Medium: avoids double-counting feature screens and session engine; current long page components increase integration effort.
acceptance_criteria: Primary journeys work for approved roles, recover from server/network errors, reject duplicate submissions and preserve form context; demo UI absent in production artifact.

name: Correct dashboard semantics and case financial presentation
scope: Define and implement scoped dashboard metrics, actual personal work counts, collected versus outstanding amounts and coherent state buckets.
remaining_work: Replace global My actions values and remaining-tax proxy for collections; expose metrics with approved exact financial semantics and appropriate aggregation.
parallelization: Alongside other frontend work; C7 owns large-data tuning.
uncertainty: High: current formulas cannot establish the correct business definition; ledger/source authority must be agreed.
acceptance_criteria: Named business examples reconcile each dashboard tile and sum to authoritative data; roles see only scoped metrics; completed/cancelled states do not masquerade as collections.

name: Validate Persian UI, accessibility and execution-paper print
scope: Harden RTL, keyboard/focus/labels, contrast, responsive tables, Jalali entry/display and official A4 print layout across approved browsers.
remaining_work: Correct print pagination, font embedding/availability and clipping; validate locale numerals/date round trips and screen-reader labels; obtain template approval.
parallelization: Alongside regression automation.
uncertainty: Medium: official signed/PDF archival output beyond existing browser print requires separate scope.
acceptance_criteria: Approved browser/viewport matrix passes primary journeys and readable multi-page print; mandatory accessibility issues resolved; printed content matches accepted official template.

name: Make backend/frontend release packaging reproducible
scope: Choose and implement one supported serving topology, deterministic locked builds, pinned toolchain, correct frontend artifact and static/dynamic route handling.
remaining_work: Resolve Maven out-directory copy versus current Next server build; fix lint script/config; separate backend tests from npm install; build immutable versioned artifacts.
parallelization: Early parallel track; no need to wait for feature completion.
uncertainty: Medium: webpack fallback proves compilation, not deployed routing; toolchain mismatch needs CI verification.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh checkout builds both artifacts using lockfile without stale target output; login callback/deep dynamic links/API work in chosen topology; lint is runnable and enforced.

name: Implement CI checks and controlled deployment pipeline
scope: Automate build, unit/integration/frontend checks, migration validation, dependency/secret/container scanning, artifact provenance and staged promotion.
remaining_work: Add CI configuration and environment deploy jobs; preserve immutable artifact between stages; capture approvals, rollout health/smoke checks and rollback entry points.
parallelization: Runs early and expands with H2/H3; platform deployments coordinated with G3.
uncertainty: Medium: CI provider/runners/registry and network access not supplied; estimates are tool-neutral.
acceptance_criteria: Merge gates reject failing tests/leaked secrets/unsafe migrations; same artifact promoted with environment config; failed deployment halts and tested rollback can be initiated.

name: Provision production-like application, Camunda and identity platform
scope: Implement repeatable environments, network segmentation/TLS, compute/storage/DB, Camunda workers/brokers and identity configuration with agreed availability and support ownership.
remaining_work: Inspect actual topology and bottlenecks; configure resource/pool/worker limits, probes, graceful shutdown, storage/retention, service accounts and staged capacity; document support/licensing ownership.
roles: SRE, workflow BE, DBA, security engineer
parallelization: Alongside application features and test harness; procurement waits external.
uncertainty: High: no infrastructure manifests or live cluster access; range assumes usable organizational compute/network and standard topology, not a new data center.
acceptance_criteria: Staging and production definitions reproducible; TLS/auth paths validated; restart/failover and worker draining preserve work; operator approves capacity, access and ownership.

name: Instrument service and business observability
scope: Add health/readiness, structured centralized logs, metrics and distributed correlation across HTTP, DB, workers and callbacks with taxpayer-data minimization.
remaining_work: Expose intake lag, pending requests, failed starts, incident age, uncorrelated callbacks, timer lateness, token failures, DB saturation and provider latency; build dashboards.
parallelization: Instrumentation can begin with interfaces; integrations add their metrics incrementally.
uncertainty: Medium: central monitoring stack/access unknown; code has no full metrics/tracing dependency/configuration.
acceptance_criteria: An intake trace follows paper/workflow/provider IDs without sensitive payloads; component probes and agreed SLIs visible; synthetic failures show up on dashboards.

name: Implement backup, restoration and cross-system reconciliation
scope: Back up application DB, actual Camunda state/storage dependencies, identity state/config and evidence references; define consistent recovery point and lost/duplicate-work reconciliation.
remaining_work: Automate encrypted off-host backups, retention and success verification; build restore scripts and reconciliation runbook; execute full staging restore and measure RPO/RTO.
parallelization: Alongside acceptance testing; H4 exercises failure behavior separately.
uncertainty: High: backing up only application DB cannot recover workflow state; multi-site DR beyond agreed topology excluded.
acceptance_criteria: Restore onto clean infrastructure meets approved RPO/RTO; record/financial/workflow counts reconcile; pending provider outcomes recovered without repeated enforcement; backup failure alerts reach owner.

name: Control schema/BPMN releases and rollback
scope: Version process IDs/resources/variables and application/schema compatibility; manage in-flight workflows, rolling worker upgrades and rollback after external side effects.
remaining_work: Add BPMN deployment automation/manifests and compatibility checks; choose drain/coexist/migrate strategy per change; rehearse rollback and forward repair without assuming external actions can be undone.
